Name: Manure Industries
Author: drewdus42
Description:
[center][size=3]This mod lets you unlock Machines that produce: Fertilizers, Retaining Soils and Speed-Gros out of animal Manure when it is put in Coops and Barns.
[/size]

[size=4]The Compost Bins have been Completely Rewritten and Overhauled[/size]
[size=2]There was several things I wanted to do that I couldn't do using the Producer Framework Mod.


[/size][color=#ff7700][size=3][u]If you are updating to 2.0 from a 1.0 version:[/u][/size][/color][size=2][color=#ff7700]
Try to pick up and destroy the old bins before updating.
Otherwise you may have the old bins show up as errors in your buildings.
Sometimes there is an issue trying to pick them up if there is an output in them.
You should be able to hit them with an upgraded hoe from over 1 tile away.[/color]
[color=#ff7700]I think using bombs on them also works.[/color]

[color=#ff7700]Worst case: reinstall the latest Old Version 1.2.0  to remove them.[/color]
[/size]

[color=#ff7700]I haven't tested with Multiplayer yet, But it should work as I designed it explicitly with multiplayer in mind.


[/color][color=#e06666][size=4][b]Please Report any bugs you find or edge cases that aren't behaving as expected
[/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#00ff00]WORKS[/color] [color=#00ff00]with[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]AUTOMATE[/url]﻿[/b]


[size=4]There are now only 3 bins, one for each type of fertilizer.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9310/9310-1718852587-1572342066.png[/img]﻿

[b][u][size=4]How to Unlock the Compost Bins:
[/size]
[/u][/b]They unlock at the corresponding Farming level for each fertilizer recipe type:


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9310/9310-1718852592-2035278898.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9310/9310-1718856408-2019583805.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9310/9310-1718856408-1210006903.png[/img]﻿



[b][u][size=4]How they work:[/size]
[/u][/b]
They only produce when in Barns or Coops.
The Compost Bins take 1 day to produce a fertilizer output.
So each morning you can collect the output.

[u]They take a few things into account:[/u]

[b][size=4]1 -[/size][/b] they take into account which fertilizer recipes you (or any other online players) have unlocked.
[b][size=4]2 -[/size][/b] what the upgrade level is of the Barn or Coop they are in.
[b][size=4]3 -[/size][/b] How many animals are living in that building.

*The more the Barn or Coop has been upgraded, the higher the quality they 'can' produce.
For example:
If you have a Deluxe Barn or Deluxe Coop, you could get up to a Deluxe Fertilizer, but if you, nor anyone you are playing with, have not unlocked that recipe, the fertilizer bin will not produce it. It will instead only produce the highest quality of the recipes you or anyone playing with you have unlocked.
The same is true for the other Building tiers.
There are 3 tiers of Buildings and 3 Quality levels of fertilizers, each tier of building can only produce fertilizers up to its corresponding quality level,
And only if at least 1 farmer has unlocked the corresponding recipe.

*If you unlock a new fertilizer recipe or upgrade your barn or coop or modify the amount of animals in the building, it could take 1 day to see the new updated output since it takes 1 day to produce.

*Each Compost Bin in a Barn or Coop will output a fertilizer stack of as many animals that were assigned when it last started producing.[/center]
